explication: Merlion is a time-series intelligence library, with separate anomaly-detection, forecasting, and change-point capabilities. Its principal workflow is to load time-series data, transform it, train or apply a model, post-process anomaly scores where relevant, and evaluate results. It also offers model selection, ensembles, visualization, a clickable dashboard, and a PySpark backend. The graph includes documented dataset and benchmarking support. Some subsystem links rely on README descriptions or SOURCE INDEX references; unsampled implementation details are not assumed.
